feedback: Written before this candidate races, so no outcome is stated for it. The candidate is a single-group change from iteration 6, the best raced design (score 64.74): kd 0.2 to 0.3, with kp 7.0, ki 0.0, outer sensors at x = ±0.06, sensor_size 0.016, base_speed 1.4 and line_loss last_direction unchanged. Every value is inside its contract range. Iteration 6 had steering_oscillation of 0.159 on the oval and 0.173 on the s-bend, against about 0.07 at kp 5 to 6 (iterations 0 and 3), so oscillation is the cost to reduce. Iteration 7 showed that lowering kp to 6.5 pulled s-bend progress back from 0.140 to 0.059 and dropped the score to 53.37, so the kp 7.0 level should be kept. Read the next race as follows. (a) If steering_oscillation falls below about 0.16 on the oval and s-bend while s-bend progress holds near 0.14 and max_error stays near 0.06 m, kd is the right lever. Keep kd 0.3 and test line_loss = search_right in a single-group revision, because slalom has lost the line once per run in every race with progress stuck near 0.10. (b) If oscillation does not fall, or jitter rises with no progress gain, the derivative is amplifying sensor noise, so return to kd 0.2 and accept the oscillation. (c) If the robot tracks without off_track but completion_time exceeds 3 s, raise base_speed to 1.6 in a later single-group revision. Report progress, max_error, line_loss_events and steering_oscillation per track, plus completion_time and rms_error. Approve: this is the best raced design with one low-risk change, and with three iterations left the race telemetry is worth more than another paper revision.
requested_changes: If steering_oscillation drops below about 0.16 with s-bend progress near 0.14 (iteration 6 baseline), keep kd = 0.3 and test line_loss = search_right in a single-group revision, since slalom has lost the line once per run in every earlier race with progress near 0.10.

If oscillation does not fall, or s-bend progress or max_error worsens, return to kd = 0.2 (the iteration 6 value) and keep kp 7.0, since iteration 7 showed that kp 6.5 cut s-bend progress from 0.140 to 0.059.
If the robot tracks without off_track but completion_time exceeds 3 s, set base_speed = 1.6 in a single-group revision, because the 3.0 s limit needs an average speed of about 1.5 m/s.
